description: List paginated recipients who received a specific branch ('if', 'else', 'shown', 'hidden', or 'skipped') of a conditional block inside a campaign, sequence email step, or transactional email, including delivery, open, click, and conversion status.

abTestVariantId.description: Optional A/B test variant ID for campaign or sequence A/B step sends.

branch.description: Branch to inspect: 'if' or 'else' for conditional groups, 'shown' or 'hidden' for conditional blocks, or 'skipped' for nested blocks whose outer rule did not match.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

end.description: ISO 8601 end of send window; send start too.

goalId.description: Optional goal ID to annotate each row's conversion flag and trackedValue.

includeMachineEngagement.description: Include machine/privacy-proxy opens and clicks (default false).

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID. Required when sourceType is 'sequence_step'.

sourceId.description: Campaign ID, sequence email step nodeId, or transactional email ID.

start.description: ISO 8601 start of send window; send end too.

name: list_conditional_block_subscribers

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_conditional_block_subscribers` MCP tool.

items.description: Paginated recipient rows: emailSendId, subscriberId, email, name, sentAt, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, complained, converted, trackedValue.
One item in the returned collection.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata (page, limit, total, totalPages, hasMore).

timedOut.description: True when the ClickHouse lookup timed out.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
